decisions.detail: minidaq_server is a TLS 1.3 server and the memory is allocated before authentication, so any client that reaches the port can exhaust the server. Update the platform package; until then keep the port on loopback or behind the site firewall (threat-model.md, section 6).
MiniDAQ uses TLS 1.3 over TCP only and never creates a DTLS context; the code is in the library but no input reaches it.

minidaq_ctl verifies the server's host name, so a forged server can crash it. No token is sent before the check, so the effect is a lost control session, not a disclosed token. Update with the platform.
MiniDAQ never signs with SM2, and runs on x86-64.

MiniDAQ calls json::parse on strings and never passes its own SAX handler. json::parse uses the library's internal DOM handler, which does not throw on its own: check that before accepting this decision, by reading the advisory's affected code.
GoogleTest is linked into the tests only (SBOM scope excluded); the shipped programs do not contain it.
